#LI- Remote Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Infrastructure & Pipeline Operations. This role is responsible for building next-generation, AI-powered automated data pipelines and scalable data repositories that enable enterprise data science and analytics at scale. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, modern data engineering tools, and feature engineering platforms, this director creates self-service, analytics-ready datasets and enterprise feature stores that empower both expert data scientists and citizen data scientists to rapidly develop, deploy, and scale models. This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.  
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and implement intelligent, self-healing data pipelines that leverage AI/ML for automated data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation.
 Build and maintain centralized feature stores that enable feature reusability across multiple models and use cases.
 Create curated data repositories optimized for data science/AI workflows, including training datasets, evaluation datasets, and production serving layers.
 Develop automated feature engineering pipelines that transform raw data into analytics-ready features with lineage tracking.
 Partner with Enterprise IT to optimize analytics platform architecture for high-performance data science workloads.
 Build automated pipelines that integrate diverse data sources including sales, CRM, patient claims, real-world evidence, and unstructured data.
 Create self-service data access layers that empower data scientists and analysts to query and extract data independently.
 Establish SLAs for data availability, freshness, and quality; implement monitoring and observability solutions.
 
 Essential Requirements 
 Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field;
 10 years of experience in data engineering, ML/AI engineering, or analytics infrastructure.
 5 years leading teams building enterprise-scale data platforms and feature stores.
 Expert knowledge of feature store technologies (Feast, Tecton, SageMaker Feature Store, Databricks Feature Store).
 Deep expertise in modern data platforms optimized for ML workloads (Databricks, Auto ML, Snowflake, BigQuery).
 Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing.
 Experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, dbt) and CI/CD for data pipelines.
 Understanding of data governance, privacy (HIPAA, GDPR), and compliance in life sciences.
 Preferred Qualities 
 Proven track record of implementing AI/ML-powered automation in data engineering workflows.
 Strategic thinker who can balance innovation (cutting-edge AI tools) with reliability (production stability).
 Builder mindset with ability to create scalable, self-service capabilities that reduce dependency on data engineering.
 Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
 Knowledge of streaming technologies, MLOps tools, and data lakehouse architecture.
 
 Novartis Compensation Summary: 
 
 The salary for this position is expected to range between $194,600 and $361,400 per year.
 
 The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.
 
 Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.
 
 US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves 
 
  
 EEO Statement: 
 
 The Novartis Group of Companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. 
  
 Accessibility and reasonable accommodations 
 
 The Novartis Group of Companies are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to us.reasonableaccommodations novartis.com or call 1(877)395-2339 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message. 
  
 Salary Range 
$194,600.00 - $361,400.00  
 Skills Desired 
Agile (Programming Methodology) (Inactive), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Value Creation, Change Management, Curious Mindset, Data Governance, Data Literacy, Data Quality, Data Science, Data Strategies, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Learning Agility, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Algorithms, Mentorship, Nlp (Neuro-Linguistic Programming) And Genai (Inactive), Organization Awareness (Inactive), Stakeholder Engagement, Statistical Analysis, Time Series Analysis, Vision (Inactive)

jobs.title: Operations Analyst A2R Assets Management
jobs.description:
Job title : Operations Analyst - A2R Assets Management 
 Location: Hyderabad
 
 About the job
 
 Sanofi Business Services (SBS), one of the 4 pillars of Sanofi’s Business Transformation organization, is setting up a captive Business Services center in Budapest to provide Finance & Accounting (Account-to-Report, Customer-Invoicing-to-Cash) as well as Employee oriented (Employee Experience) services. With respect to Account to Report (A2R) the Business Services center will be covering the following areas of the process:
 Assets Management
 Tax Accounting
 Intercompany Accounting
 Treasury Accounting
 GL Accounts Closing and Reporting
 
 We are seeking a dynamic and accountable professional to join our A2R Fixed Assets team. This role goes beyond transactional processing and requires strong ownership, leadership, and strategic thinking to manage the fixed assets lifecycle and contribute to broader finance transformation initiatives.
 
 Own and manage the end-to-end fixed assets accounting process in SAP. Ensure accurate asset capitalization, transfers, disposals, and depreciation Run. Monitor and process monthly depreciation runs. Reconcile fixed assets sub-ledger with general ledger. Lead and support  month-end and year-end close activities , including reconciliations and reporting. Contribute to transition planning, knowledge sharing, and backup resource training. Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using tools like SAP and Blackline. 
 
 About you 
 
 Experience : 5-8 years of experience in fixed assets accounting or general ledger.
 Technical skills : Proficiency in SAP (especially Asset Accounting module). Strong Excel skills: experience with Blackline is a plus. Good understanding of IFRS/GAAP accounting principles. Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and contribute to strategic initiatives.
 Compliance & Controls : Maintain compliance with internal controls, SOX, and accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP). Provide insights and support for audits and Maintain documentation and support internal/external audits.
 Education :  Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field. MBA, MCom CA(IPCC), CMA(Inter).
 Ownership & Strategic Contribution: Take full ownership of assigned entities and ensure timely and accurate reporting. Act as a key point of contact for cross-functional teams (Controlling, Projects, Procurement) to ensure alignment and data consistency. Identify and drive process improvements, automation opportunities, and standardization across entities. Support transition planning, onboarding, and training of new or backup resources.
 Leadership Responsibilities: Lead and mentor team members, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning. Support transition planning, cross-training, and succession readiness within the team. Monitor KPIs and contribute to performance reviews and continuous improvement efforts.
 Languages : Excellent communication in English. 
 Working Hours : Be responsible for the period-end closing and reporting in accordance with Sanofi month end close schedule. The associate may need to work in different working hours during the month-end closing period for 5-7 days, depending on the region they support.
 
 
 
 Pursue progress , discover extraordinary 
 Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
 
 At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ability or gender identity.
 
 Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com !

jobs.description:
ISP India Private Limited 
 
 Are you the kind of person that is always thinking, sketching, seeking, and adjusting? Who needs to understand how things work and then figure out how they can work better? Are you a passionate, tenacious solver who loves to work with others who share your drive? Are you positive, constructive, and ingenious? 
 Are you always solving? 
 Then we d like to meet you and bet you d like to meet us.
 Ashland has an exciting opportunity for an HCM Analyst to join our Ashland Inc business. This is a highly visible and impactful role within the Company and the Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) function. This position will report to the HRIS Manager .
 
 The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:
 Serve as a functional analyst and subject matter expert for Workday and other HR technology platforms.
 Configure, test, troubleshoot, and support business processes, reports, security, and system enhancements across the HCM ecosystem.
 Partner with HR, Payroll, Compensation, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
 Develop and maintain custom reports, dashboards, and analytics that support business decision-making.
 Support Workday releases, system updates, and enhancement projects, including testing and validation activities.
 Investigate and resolve system issues while maintaining data integrity and compliance with internal controls.
 Assist with HR system integrations and coordinate with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors.
 Document business processes, system configurations, testing results, and support procedures.
 Work alongside a team of HR technology professionals focused on innovation, process improvement, and delivering a world-class employee experience.
 Bring forward new ideas, automation opportunities, and creative solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
 Actively contribute to the organizational goals by taking initiative, executing on goals and focusing on performance and safety.
 Improve the organization capacity and capabilities through building collaborative relationships, optimizing diverse talent and utilizing positive communications and influence with others.
 
 What This Role Is Not:
 Not a management position – this is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.
 Not a help desk role – while support activities are involved, a significant portion of the role focuses on analysis, configuration, projects, and continuous improvement.
 Not a purely technical developer position – success requires balancing technical system knowledge with business process understanding.
 Not an entry-level position – candidates should be able to quickly contribute to projects, enhancements, and system support activities.
 
 In order to be qualified for this role, you must possess the following:
 Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Minimum of 4 years of experience supporting Workday, HRIS, HCM, or related enterprise systems.
 Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into system solutions.
 Experience creating reports, dashboards, and data analysis using HR systems.
 Experience troubleshooting production issues and coordinating resolution activities.
 Experience testing system enhancements, upgrades, and new functionality.
 Strong knowledge of HR business processes and employee lifecycle transactions.
 Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.
 Demonstrated responsible and ethical behavior at all times.
 The ability to help the company drive greater value through understanding the business, making complex decisions and creating the new and different.
 
 The following skill sets are preferred by the business unit:
 Workday certification or advanced Workday experience.
 Experience with Workday business processes, reporting, security, or integrations.
 Experience supporting Payroll, Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, or Recruiting modules.
 Experience with EIBs
 Knowledge of SOX controls, audit requirements, or HR data governance.
 Experience supporting a global workforce and HR organization.

Job title : Analyst - Data & Process Management
 Location : Hyderabad
 % of travel expected : Travel required as per business need, if any
 Job type : Permanent and Full time
 
 About the job
 
 Strategic context: 
   
 As part of GTMC, Insights & Analytics Capabilities delivers best-in-class and transformative insights and innovative tools and methods that actionably fuel Sanofi’s strategic business decisions, processes, and deliverables. In doing so, our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready?
 
 Overall Purpose: At Sanofi, we leverage analytics and technology to benefit patients worldwide. We seek individuals passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making and tackle global health threats. Our mission is to transform decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management. The Specialist in Market Research and Competitive Intelligence will provide deliverables that support planning and decision-making across multiple functional areas, such as finance, manufacturing, product development, and commercial. This role ensures high-quality deliverables, drives synergies across franchises, fosters innovation, and creates scalable, shareable solutions.
 
 Main responsibilities: 
 The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:
 At our Sanofi we are leveraging analytics and technology, on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision making that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
 Within our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.
 Deliverables support planning and decision making across multiple commercial areas such as Analytics, Campaign Ops and market mix.
 In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across the franchise, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes. As we endeavour, we are seeking a dynamic talent for the role of “Analyst – Data & Process Management”. 
 We are looking for a team member to support our data management team based out of US. Robust data management is a priority for our businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines.
 It is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement innovative techniques to drive our data management strategies across franchises.
 He/she will ensure on time and accurate delivery of data requirements by collaborating with relevant stakeholders.
 He/she will ensure Data availability, data quality and data completeness are maintained as per requirements and are delivered in timely manner.
 Ensuring data consistency across the sources and downstream teams.
 Pro-actively identifying data requirements and gaps in system.
 Developing SOPs for data management processes and leading the process enhancements.
 Providing training to end users on usage of data across the sources.
 Building advance tools and automate or improve processes for analytical and other needs 
 People: 
 Maintain effective relationship with the end stakeholders within the allocated GBU and tasks – with an end objective to develop education and communication content as per requirement
 Actively lead and develop SBO operations associates and ensure new technologies are leveraged
 Initiate the contracting process and related documents within defined timelines; and
 Collaborate with global stakeholders for project planning and setting up the timelines and maintaining budget
 Performance: 
 Ensure data supplied by CDM is used effectively by stakeholders in commercial operations processes (forecasting targeting, call planning, alignments, field reporting, incentive compensation and market mix).
 Administer CDM activities related to the quarterly operations cycle.
 Monitor data quality reports and investigate problems.
 Maintain requirements documents, business rules and metadata.
 Provide first-level support for sales/claims/MDM/omnichannel data inquiries.
 Provide ad-hoc support to US CDM team.
 Works to develop data management analytics and reporting capabilities
 Collaborates with Digital to enhance data access across various sources, develop tools, technology, and process to constantly improve quality and productivity
 Support in key data management activities such as developing a right data quality framework, data cataloguing, data profiling.   Process: 
 Contribute to overall quality enhancement by ensuring high standards for the output produced by the digital and data management team.
 Secure adherence to compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with all applicable standards
 Refresh reports on frequency/cycle basis (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annually), along with QC checks for each refresh
 Manage opt out compliance for universe of healthcare professionals.
 Stakeholder: Work closely with global teams and/ external vendors to ensure the end-to-end effective project delivery of with complete data availability.
 About you
 Experience : 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial datasets like IQVIA, APLD, LAAD, MMIT, Customer Engagement and execution data, etc. 
 Soft skills : Strong learning agility; Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of the business; Good interpersonal and communication skills; strong presentation skills a must; Team player who is curious, dynamic, result oriented and can work collaboratively; Ability to think strategically in an ambiguous environment; Ability to operate effectively in an international matrix environment, with ability to work across time zones; Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques
 Technical skills :
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
 At least 3 years direct experience with pharmaceutical sales data and data management with the emphasis on IQVIA syndicated datasets, Specialty Pharmacy and claims datasets.
 Strong technical background in SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, Informatica, AWS etc.
 Experience of using AI tools to drive accelerated data governance outcomes is a plus
 Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical sales and marketing data sources (IQVIA, Veeva etc.) Knowledge of and/or experience in pharmaceuticals sales operations; understands how data is applied in a pharmaceutical’s commercial operations context.

Job title: Business system owner HighRadius Cloud–Analyst 
 Location: Hyderabad
 
 About the job 
 
 Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability & interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.
 In the context of our digital transformation, we are upgrading HighRadius Cloud to support Customer Invoicing to Cash activities and more specifically Collections and Cash Application management. We are enhancing this platform with advanced automation and analytics capabilities to drive collector efficiency, improve DSO performance, and deliver operational excellence across 80 countries. Reporting to the BSO Manager – HighRadius Cloud Collections & Cash Application, the BSO Analyst assists in the day-to-day operations of the HighRadius Cloud platform for Collections and Cash Application across 80 countries. The main activities include:
 She/he assists in leveraging HighRadius Cloud solution capabilities, including automation and analytics, to deliver the highest value possible to Collections and Cash Application activities on a daily basis.
 She/he participates in business activities in the context of the HighRadius upgrade across 80 countries to facilitate collector adoption, reduce DSO, and improve cash application automation, in collaboration with K-users, Digital, and the HighRadius vendor.
 She/he monitors global adoption (target: 85% daily collector login) and tracks platform performance.
 This role requires a good understanding of Collections and Cash Application processes within the Order to Cash cycle, a problem-solving mindset, and hands-on knowledge of HighRadius Cloud (Collections and Cash Application modules), ticket management, and testing activities.
 
 Main responsibilities: 
 Support HighRadius Cloud platform operations for Collections and Cash Application: Monitor platform health and overnight job completion. Execute review of collector worklist generation and anomalies. Assist in ticket triage and routing of incoming support tickets (L1/L2). Verify SAP ↔ HighRadius data sync (AR balances, master data). Track strategy execution monitoring and automation rate performance. Update rule-based collection strategies Review open incidents and maintain oversight of SLA compliance. Maintain KPI dashboard updates and overdue trend reports. Monitor collector adoption metrics (login/worklist usage rate).
 Participate in HighRadius upgrade and configuration activities: Collect and consolidate business requirements from SMEs, GPLs, and local teams. Prepare business specifications for Digital and HighRadius. Execute UAT preparation: test scripts, key user training materials, test coordination. Track and report on execution and incident resolution during UAT. Deliver key user responsibilities during end-user training sessions.
 Engage in post go-live activities: solution/process clarification and issue follow-up. Document configuration changes, global design settings, and change requests in centralized repository. Execute regression testing activities before platform changes go live. Present expected enhancements in partnership with Digital to the appropriate governance (Design Authority, ERP screening committee).
 Engage in continuous improvement, reporting and analytics: Gather and consolidate feedback from Hub, local CI2C, GPO, and GPL teams on platform improvements. Monitor post-launch initiatives: overdue improvement, collector productivity, auto-match rates. Track KPI performance: DSO trends, overdue rates, worklist completion rates, auto-match rates. Ensure Reporting and Analytics needs are met: deliver daily collector dashboards, management reporting, overdue trend analysis, and cash application performance tracking.
 Maintain data foundation build and KPI enhancement for HighRadius data. Validate data accuracy in reports and dashboards. Update and maintain training documentation. Communicate to stakeholders about feature delivery and platform updates. Build HighRadius platform expertise within the K-user community (SME’s).
 Participate in HighRadius vendor relationship and ticket governance: Track SLA compliance across all incident priorities (P1–P4). Attend monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with HighRadius. Record and maintain all configuration changes and change requests in ServiceNow. Manage the Change Request (CR) pipeline tracking. Execute HighRadius ticket governance in ServiceNow: priority classification, RCA documentation follow-up, resolution tracking. Document root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents. Verify regression testing checklists are completed before UAT.
 
 About you: 
 Experience: 2–3 years experience in Collections and/or Cash Application within an Order to Cash environment (essential). Experience with HighRadius in a multinational company (essential). Experience supporting Business System Owner (BSO) responsibilities and governance. Hands-on experience with HighRadius Collections and/or Cash Application modules (essential). Understanding of Collections and Cash Application processes end-to-end, including dunning, dispute management, customer segmentation, payment matching, and deduction management. Experience with DSO management concepts and collector productivity improvement. Good business acumen (advantageous). Strong problem solving, deductive, and analytical skills.
 Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with HighRadius Cloud Collections and/or Cash Application modules (essential). Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC integration with HighRadius (essential). Understanding of collection strategy configuration, worklist management, dunning rule setup, and cash application matching rule design. Knowledge of Reporting and Analytics tools; ability to contribute to KPI frameworks and dashboard validation. Knowledge of ServiceNow for incident and change request management (advantageous). Knowledge of Jira (advantageous). Knowledge of Microsoft Office and expertise in MS Excel and PowerPoint (essential).
 Interpersonal: Self-motivated, well organized, hard-working, detail-minded, clear thinker, quick learner. Well-inclined towards change and ability to work under pressure. Good capability to work in a global scope collaborating with transversal teams across different geographies. Good communication skills (essential). Ability to contribute to technology roadmaps for Collections and Cash Application capabilities. Ability to manage quality of service KPIs including DSO, overdue, collector adoption, auto-match rates. Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders between business teams and technology experts. Ability to support multiple projects with various milestones and deadlines. 
 Languages : Excellent English written and verbal.
 
 Why choose us? 
 Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
 Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
 Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Job Title: Analyst - PowerBI Developer
 GCL:C3
 Introduction to role:
 Are you ready to turn complex commercial data into clear decisions that accelerate access to life-changing medicines? Join our Chennai-based reporting and analytics team to engineer enterprise-grade Power BI solutions that scale across dozens of markets and drive faster, smarter decisions for the business and, ultimately, for patients.
 Here you will own impactful solutions end-to-end, from requirements discovery to production support, translating real-world objectives into robust, secure, and high-performing data products. You will contribute to setting engineering standards, optimise semantic models, and advance automation and reuse so our delivery teams move with pace and consistency. Do you thrive in fast paced, high-performing teams and enjoy mentoring others while improving the standard r on quality?
 Accountabilities:
 Solution Ownership: Lead the design, development, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, high-performing Power BI solutions that turn commercial and omnichannel data into actionable insight.
 Semantic Modelling and Performance: Build and optimise star-schema models, calculations, and DAX to deliver fast, reliable analytics at enterprise scale.
 Engineering Standards and Reuse: Define and promote standards, templates, and automation to increase consistency, reduce cycle time, and improve maintainability across reports and models.
 Data Quality and Governance: Ensure accuracy, accessibility, and actionability through rigorous source-to-report reconciliation, row-level security, lineage tracking, and regulated dissemination procedures.
 Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to business users, analysts, data engineers, governance teams, and delivery partners, translating objectives into technical designs with clear trade-offs.
 Mentoring and Reviews: Coach developers, lead design and code reviews, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
 Operational Excellence: Manage delivery workflows, gateways, and refresh strategies; diagnose and resolve issues related to reports, models, and security throughout the entire flow to keep solutions reliable.
 Agile Delivery: Estimate work, manage dependencies and risks, run UAT, and deliver several projects simultaneously in Agile or Scrum environments.
 Omnichannel Insight Enablement: Interpret campaign and channel metrics to generate insights that improve customer engagement and commercial impact across markets.
 Essential Skills/Experience:
 Bachelor’s Degree
 4- 6 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or data management, with at least 4years of hands-on Power BI solution delivery.
 Advanced proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and row-level security.
 Expertise in DAX, Power Query, dimensional modelling, star schemas, calculation design, and performance optimisation for large or complex data models.
 Strong SQL skills and experience integrating data from relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, files, and enterprise applications.
 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot report, model, refresh, gateway, security, and data-quality issues across the end-to-end reporting flow.
 Experience with requirements elicitation, technical design, estimation, documentation, testing, source-to-report reconciliation, UAT, deployment, and production support.
 Understanding of enterprise data governance, information security, access controls, data lineage, quality management, and controlled release practices.
 Proven experience leading technical discussions, reviewing builds and code, mentoring developers, and influencing collaborators without direct authority.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritisation, and communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
 Experience delivering multiple initiatives in parallel within Agile or Scrum teams, including risk management, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
 Knowledge of omnichannel, commercial, or digital marketing analytics and experience translating campaign and channel metrics into actionable insights.
 Desirable Skills/Experience:
 Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry, particularly commercial or omnichannel reporting.
 Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable cloud analytics platforms.
 Familiarity with DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer, source control, CI/CD, Power Automate, REST APIs, or scripting for administration and automation.
 Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or a relevant Microsoft Fabric certification.
 Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Agile delivery, technical documentation, and structured knowledge transfer.
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn t mean we re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
 Why AstraZeneca:
 Here your technical craft directly supports our purpose to improve patients’ lives, as you partner with diverse experts to build data products that power decisions across the enterprise. You will work with modern tools and cloud platforms while learning from a global network that prizes curiosity, rigour, and knowledge-sharing. We act swiftly, challenge assumptions, and take smart risks, pairing ambition with kindness so you can grow while making tangible impact. In In this role, you will help reimagine how we work by using data, automation, and predictive insight. This will free time for discovery and bring clarity to complex commercial questions.

 Ready to lead high-impact Power BI solutions and see your work drive better, faster decisions for patients and the business—take the next step and share your profile today!

jobs.title: Digital HR Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title: Digital HR Product Analyst 
 Career Level: C 
 Introduction to role:
 Are you prepared to transform complex HR needs into clear, scalable digital solutions that power hiring and talent growth across a global enterprise? In this role, you will sit at the heart of how we evolve our Talent Acquisition and Talent Management products, ensuring every change is grounded in real user needs and delivers measurable outcomes for the business and, ultimately, for patients.
 You will be the first line of clarity for product demand, shaping ideas into actionable requirements and guiding them through delivery in collaboration with Product Managers, HRIT, process experts and technology vendors. Could you translate a flood of requests into a coherent, prioritised backlog that improves user journeys and accelerates our impact? With exposure to platforms such as Workday, Eightfold and specialist tools including HireVue, Radancy, LinkedIn and Fieldglass, you will help create a consistent and reliable experience for HR users worldwide.
 
 Accountabilities:
 Tickets and Demand Triaging: Bring structure to incoming queries, incidents, access requests and enhancement ideas by clarifying the problem, user groups, urgency and impact; route each item correctly and recommend whether it progresses, is redirected or addressed via guidance or training.
 Requirements and Impact Assessment: Convert validated needs into detailed problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; assess implications across processes, user journeys, data, integrations, access, privacy and security; identify gaps, dependencies and risks and involve specialists where required; maintain traceability from need to validation outcome.
 Maintain complete and auditable records in ServiceNow and other tools. De-duplicate and link related items. Clarify readiness and provide evidence for prioritisation. Ensure ownership, next actions, and partner communications are clear. Monitor progress and raise blockers through governance.
 Evaluate options with HRIT and vendors based on original requirements and the broader product landscape. Coordinate business validation and end-user testing, including scenarios, acceptance criteria, participation, results, and defect management. Confirm outcomes and ensure gaps are detailed and addressed. Support release readiness and change planning.
 Provide timely and transparent updates on status, decisions, and next steps. Explain product and technical details in accessible language. Set realistic expectations while building confidence that requests are understood and managed consistently.
 Collaboration and Portfolio Support: Build strong working relationships across product, process, HRIT and vendor teams; develop broad knowledge of the portfolio to provide flexible support across products as priorities shift; supply to team resilience through knowledge sharing, documentation and coverage.
 
 Essential Skills/Experience:
 Practical experience in product analysis, business analysis or HR technology, including requirements, demand assessment,or product support in an enterprise environment.
 Ability to investigate a business or user problem, ask thoughtful questions and translate collaborator input into clear, structured and proportionate requirements.
 Ability to assess scope, impact, priority, dependencies and risk, and to recognise when specialist product, process, technical or business input is needed.
 Experience supporting user acceptance testing, including defining scenarios and success criteria, engaging users, recording results, capturing defects and confirming whether a solution meets the intended outcome.
 Strong organisation and attention to detail, capable of handling multiple requests at different stages, maintaining accurate records and following through on agreed actions.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including proficiency at explaining product or technical considerations in a clear, practical and accessible way.
 Effective relationship-building skills and experience working collaboratively across business, product, process and technology teams.
 A curious, customer-focused and practical outlook, with the rigor to ensure requests are accurately analysed and managed in a global, matrix environment.
 
 Desirable Skills/Experience:
 Experience with Workday and/or Eightfold or any other HR System
 Familiarity with Talent Acquisition or Talent Management technologies, including platforms similar to HireVue, Radancy, LinkedIn, or Fieldglass, is a plus
 Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable service-management platform to track demand, manage workflows, maintain records and provide collaborator updates.
 AI and Digital Fluency, Demonstrable curiosity and confidence in using AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, productivity and stakeholder support. Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, apply appropriate human judgement, and use AI responsibly in line with data privacy, security and organisational standards.
 Understanding of HR data, access, privacy, security and integration considerations within enterprise HR systems.
 Awareness of candidate, employee, recruiter and manager journeys, and how digital products support these user groups.
 Experience analysing product-support trends, user feedback, adoption information or service data to identify insights and improvement opportunities.
 Experience working with collaborators across multiple countries, cultures and time zones.
 Familiarity with technology releases, vendor roadmaps and the evaluation of new product functionality.
 
 Why AstraZeneca:
 Join a global team that blends ambition with support, where unexpected combinations of expertise come together to solve complex challenges and speed smarter decisions. You will work alongside talented colleagues, leverage modern platforms and data-driven practices, and help reimagine how work gets done so our scientists and clinicians can focus on discovery that changes patients’ lives. We value curiosity as much as rigour, encourage thoughtful challenge, and provide the tools, networks and learning opportunities to build a diverse career while making a tangible impact.
 
 Call to Action:
 If you are ready to turn insight into outcomes and shape how digital HR products fuel our growth, take the next step and make your mark with us today!
